subject: Re: Fintrax SLA - safety valve / escrow proposal
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintrax.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintrax.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Fintrax SLA request - escrow + termination safety valve

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Fintrax is excited about Redwood's throughput and billing transparency. Procurement/legal have asked us to formalize stronger commercial safeguards in the event of service degradation. Attached is our starting point (Fintrax_SLA_Request_2027-07-19.pdf).

High level asks:
- Fee at risk / escrow: place 50% of monthly spend for the first 6 months into escrow that Redwood would forfeit if certain uptime/latency commitments are missed.
- Termination right: Fintrax can terminate for convenience if a severity-1 outage > 48 hours occurs or if monthly uptime drops below 99.0% for two consecutive months.
- Liquidated damages formula: a per-incident fee calculated as X% of MRR, to be payable after an unresolved escalation to execs.

We understand this is outside standard public terms; we want to surface it early so we can align commercial/legal before looping finance. Can you confirm if Redwood can accept fee-at-risk + termination rights, or propose alternatives (credit-only, capped escrow, objective metrics)?

Attachments: Fintrax_SLA_Request_2027-07-19.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Best,
Alex
Director, Procurement
Fintrax Payments
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintrax.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fintrax SLA request - escrow + termination safety valve

Alex — thanks for sending this and for the clear bullets. I’ve reviewed the PDF at a high level; appreciate the clarity about the conditions you’re targeting.

Quick response and next steps from our side:
- We can engage legal to review the proposed escrow / liquidated damages language, but those asks are outside our standard hosted SLA and will need executive sign-off.
- As an interim product-level mitigation, we can evaluate offering Dedicated capacity or SLO guarantees tied to specific model/route pairs to reduce the probability of the events you describe.
- Can you confirm the typical monthly spend baseline so we can size any escrow proposal? Also confirm whether Fintrax expects the escrow to be held by a neutral third party or simply contractually reserved.

I’m looping Ben (commercial lead) and Priyom (contracts) so we can give a consolidated counterproposal by EOD on Wed. If possible, can you have legal enumerate the exact contract language you want for termination / LD so we can accelerate legal review?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marie Dupont <m.dupont@fintrax.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintrax.com>, procurement@fintrax.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fintrax SLA request - escrow + termination safety valve

Hannah — thank you. For clarity from Legal:
- Proposal: escrow equal to 50% of average monthly invoices for first 6 months; escrow payable to Fintrax if Redwood fails to meet either (a) monthly uptime >= 99.5% or (b) 95th percentile token latency <= 350ms for two consecutive months.
- Termination: Fintrax may terminate for convenience with 30 days' notice if (i) a single S1 outage > 48 hours occurs, or (ii) the above uptime/latency thresholds are missed for two consecutive months and Redwood does not cure within 14 days.
- Liquidated damages: if termination is triggered under (ii), Fintrax seeks a fixed LD equal to 2x monthly spend (not to exceed the escrow amount).

We can provide redline text; attaching the language we will push (Fintrax_Legal_Redlines.docx). We’re open to a cap and objective measurement, but the escrow + termination combo is commercially important to our board.

Marie Dupont
General Counsel (interim)
Fintrax Payments
Attachments: Fintrax_Legal_Redlines.docx (DOCX, 3 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dupont <m.dupont@fintrax.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintrax.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 13:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fintrax SLA request - escrow + termination safety valve

Marie / Alex — really appreciate the clarity. A few commercial counters from Redwood:
- Escrow size: we can’t agree to 50% of MRR in escrow for a hosted service. We can propose an escrow set at 25% of MRR for the first 3 months with an objective trigger and automatic release schedule tied to meeting SLOs.
- Termination trigger: we’re open to a termination right for S1 outage >72 hours (not 48) and for sustained SLA misses, but we’d ask for a cure window of 30 days before termination, and an executive escalation ladder that provides automatic fallback routing to Dedicated capacity as a remediation option.
- Liquidated damages: we can agree to a fixed LD formula but propose capping it at 3x monthly spend and carving out force majeure and operator misconfiguration. Also we’d prefer LD to be payable after an independent audit of the metrics.

Product note: to reduce likelihood of sustained breaches we can offer a temporary Dedicated pool for Fintrax for the first 90 days at a discounted rate, plus a set of observability dashboards and a joint runbook. That materially lowers the risk of the events you’re worried about.

I’ll follow up with a draft counter (Redwood_counter_ESR_v1.pdf) by EOD; Priyom will drive the legal wording next week. If you’re available, let’s set a 30-min session with legal and ops tomorrow to align.

— Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_counter_ESR_v1.pdf (PDF, 4 pages)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintrax.com>, Marie Dupont <m.dupont@fintrax.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 16:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fintrax SLA request - safety valve / escrow proposal — proposed middle ground

Alex / Marie — thanks for the fast responses. Summarizing Redwood’s middle-ground we’d like you to take to your board:

Proposed compromise (summary):
- Escrow: 30% of average monthly invoices placed in third-party escrow for the first 6 months only; released on a monthly pro-rata schedule tied to meeting the stated SLOs.
- Termination: Fintrax may terminate for convenience if either (1) a single S1 outage > 72 hours occurs, or (2) the defined uptime/latency thresholds are missed for three consecutive months and Redwood does not cure within 30 days.
- Liquidated damages: LD payable up to a cap of 3x monthly spend and not to exceed escrowed funds; payable after independent metric verification.
- Mitigation offer: Redwood will provision a Dedicated pool for Fintrax for the first 90 days at 25% off list to materially reduce outage risk; we’ll provide dashboard access and a joint runbook.

Next steps: Ben will finalize the counter draft for contracts; Priyom will work with our counsel to produce redline language for the DocuSign envelope. If Fintrax is amenable to the 30% escrow / 72-hour S1 threshold and the cap on LD, we can fast-track legal review and aim to have a signed amendment within two weeks.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the compromise — propose 11:00 AM ET tomorrow. Meeting link: https://cal.redwood.example/hannah/30min

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
